<thought>To locate the appropriate retrosynthetic template for the Wolff‑Kishner reduction, I will search the template catalog for reactions that break a “ketones” functional group. A simple ketone (propanone) can serve as the target molecule for the search.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(=O)C",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones"],
    "functional_groups_formed": null,
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "bonds_order_changed": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
